blocks.text: __**Your PC must be Wired (one way or another)**__

Supported ways that you are able to connect your Headset and PC:

* If your Headset connects with Wifi, then your PC must connect with Ethernet to the same Gigabit (or better) router that your Headset connects to. Connecting your PC and your headset with Wifi **at the same time** causes too many issues and is not supported. Visit https://discord.com/channels/564087419918483486/767976061476405269 for more information.

* Connecting your Headset to a PC hotspot is possible but the performance is terrible and we do not recommend it.

* Otherwise, Quest headsets can connect directly to the PC via USB if you install the Virtual Desktop Beta. This method works well if you have a high quality USB port and cable. Visit https://discord.com/channels/564087419918483486/592909523295928340 for more information.

* Also, many headsets, (including Quest models,  Pico 4 Ultra, PFD and Galaxy XR) are able to use an Ethernet to USB adapter to connect directly to the PC. Due to the inconsistency in the quality of USB ports and cables, this method is found to be better than direct USB. Visit https://discord.com/channels/564087419918483486/1390686127937159209 and/or type /dongle here in the channel for more information.
